rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: In his presidential address headed 'National Council Session, August 27-28, 2000 (Nagpur)', Shri Bangaru Laxman expresses gratitude 'to all of you for electing me the Fifth President of the Bharatiya Janata Party' and seeks cooperation 'in my work as Party President for the next three years'.
